_comment: DATA-ONLY WATCHLIST (added 2026-09-13) — see watchlist_eodhd.json for why these names are held out of M1. Fetched by fetch_tiingo.py in the tiingo pod, before the main pass, into data_tiingo/watchlist/; build_m1 and validate read data_tiingo/*.json only. DAILY, unlike the main config's 30-day cadence: skip_fresh_days 0.5 refetches each nightly run but skips a same-day relaunch (a whole 1 would skip a run that starts a few minutes earlier than yesterday's). 2026-09-16: the 11 promoted names moved to tiingo.json and their files to data_tiingo/, leaving BRK-B + SPY/QQQ — 3 symbols, ~6 requests split over the three free tokens, far inside 50/hr each; the 72s pacing is kept so the main pass that follows in the same hour cannot trip a 429. Barely touches each account's 500-unique-symbols/month cap.
